rv.q: White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a wildly entertaining and still very current production, wholly unique and well worth seeing.
White Rabbit Red Rabbit is as interesting for its history and background as it is in its own right.
This is a production not to be missed: a performance that exists only in the very moment that you watch it.
This simplicity paired with the intimate venue of the Duchess Theatre creates the perfect playful environment for this bold theatrical experience.
It’s a testament to the text that it is open to such interpretation and possibility...
All in all, White Rabbit Red Rabbit is a deeply moving and, at times, thrilling theatrical experiment.
White Rabbit Red Rabbit is an unusual and thought-provoking theatrical experiment, with the unpredictability of a new performer each week built into its DNA.

cn.t: Critics praise this gripping theatrical experiment where actors perform Soleimanpour's script sight unseen, calling it a fascinating fusion of cold-read and improv that creates a deeply personal, allegorical experience bridging performer and audience.

lo.inst: Enter via TodayTix app only. Draws Thursdays at 11 AM. Performances only on occasional Mondays.
